name: section_controls
label: Section Controls
help_text: This group contains modules which affect various parts of this section, such as layout, spacing, or miscellaneous settings specific to this section.

children.name: anchor_id
children.label: Anchor ID
children.help_text: Add a unique ID to allow anchor links to this section. Only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores are permitted. (Example: section-name) When linking to this section in an inline hyperlink, place a hashtag before the anchor ID.

children.name: device_visibility
children.label: Device Visibility
children.help_text: Use this dropdown to determine when to show/hide this section. When only showing this section on certain screen sizes, ensure this section does not contain necessary features like an anchor or design elements that are necessary for the page's appearance such as angles or background gradients. Also ensure any related sections such as dividers are also appropriately configured to only show when needed.

children.name: text_color_override
children.label: Text Color Override
children.help_text: This module will override any text which appears directly on your background. Use this module to make all text white when using a darker background color to ensure the text is legible.

children.name: content_alignment_desktop
children.label: Content Alignment (Desktop)
children.help_text: If using a Video with a Video Label for the Featured Media in this section, please note that the Center alignment option for this input includes the height of the video label which will cause your alignment not to appear centered.

name: spacing
label: Spacing
help_text: Use these modules to control the spacing at the top and bottom of this section. This is especially useful for reducing white space between sections which share the same background color.

children.name: top_padding_custom
children.label: Top Padding: Custom Padding Amount
children.help_text: The significance of this number is determined by the Top Padding: Custom Padding Measurement Unit input.

children.name: top_padding_custom_measurement_unit
children.label: Top Padding: Custom Padding Measurement Unit
children.help_text: This input determines the significance of the Top Padding: Custom Padding Amount input. This can be set to a static number of pixels, a percentage based on screen width, or a percentage based on screen height. This is useful when the background of this section requires a specific amount of space that should either be a static amount of space or scale based on screen width or height.

children.name: top_padding_mobile_custom
children.label: Top Padding: Custom Padding Amount (Mobile)
children.help_text: The significance of this number is determined by the Top Padding: Custom Padding Measurement Unit (Mobile) input.

children.name: top_padding_mobile_custom_measurement_unit
children.label: Top Padding: Custom Padding Measurement Unit (Mobile)
children.help_text: This input determines the significance of the Top Padding: Custom Padding Amount (Mobile) input. This can be set to a static number of pixels, a percentage based on screen width, or a percentage based on screen height. This is useful when the background of this section requires a specific amount of space that should either be a static amount of space or scale based on screen width or height.

children.name: bottom_padding_custom
children.label: Bottom Padding: Custom Padding Amount
children.help_text: The significance of this number is determined by the Bottom Padding: Custom Padding Measurement Unit input.

children.name: bottom_padding_custom_measurement_unit
children.label: Bottom Padding: Custom Padding Measurement Unit
children.help_text: This input determines the significance of the Bottom Padding: Custom Padding Amount input. This can be set to a static number of pixels, a percentage based on screen width, or a percentage based on screen height. This is useful when the background of this section requires a specific amount of space that should either be a static amount of space or scale based on screen width or height.

children.name: bottom_padding_mobile_custom
children.label: Bottom Padding: Custom Padding Amount (Mobile)
children.help_text: The significance of this number is determined by the Bottom Padding: Custom Padding Measurement Unit (Mobile) input.

children.name: bottom_padding_mobile_custom_measurement_unit
children.label: Bottom Padding: Custom Padding Measurement Unit (Mobile)
children.help_text: This input determines the significance of the Bottom Padding: Custom Padding Amount (Mobile) input. This can be set to a static number of pixels, a percentage based on screen width, or a percentage based on screen height. This is useful when the background of this section requires a specific amount of space that should either be a static amount of space or scale based on screen width or height.

name: background
label: Background Layers
help_text: Add one or more background layers here. Layers are overlaid on top of each other with the first layer in your list being the back and the last layer in your list being the front. Using multiple layers allows you to stack multiple levels of imagery on top of each other such as a background image with an overlay or texture. After changing settings in this module group, click Apply to preview your changes.

children.name: device_visibility
children.label: Device Visibility
children.help_text: Use this dropdown to determine when to show/hide this background layer. When only showing this layer on certain screen sizes, ensure this layer is not necessary for your content to be legible.

children.name: background_opacity
children.label: Background: Opacity
children.help_text: Use this module to adjust this background layer's opacity (transparency). 100 is solid and 0 is completely transparent.

children.name: background_custom_color
children.label: Background: Custom Color
children.help_text: The opacity for this module is intended to be 100%, otherwise your color will display lighter than intended.

children.name: background_gradient_custom_start_color
children.label: Background: Gradient Custom Start Color
children.help_text: The opacity for this module is intended to be 100%, otherwise your color will display lighter than intended.

children.name: background_gradient_start_color_position
children.label: Background Gradient: Start Color Position
children.help_text: This number determines where the start color will be positioned in the gradient. This number represents a percentage of the linear gradient from start to finish, with 0 being the start and 100 being the end. Anything between this number and 0 will use your gradient start color settings, whereas anything between this number and the end color will be the transition area between the two colors.  This number must be less than the value of your gradient end color, otherwise it may cause issues with the direction of your gradient. (Default: 0)

children.name: background_gradient_custom_end_color
children.label: Background: Gradient Custom End Color
children.help_text: The opacity for this module is intended to be 100%, otherwise your color will display lighter than intended.

children.name: background_gradient_end_color_position
children.label: Background Gradient: End Color Position
children.help_text: This number determines where the end color will be positioned in the gradient. This number represents a percentage of the linear gradient from start to finish, with 0 being the start and 100 being the end. Anything between this number and 100 will use your gradient end color settings, whereas anything between this number and the start color will be the transition area between the two colors.  This number must be greater than the value of your gradient start color, otherwise it may cause issues with the direction of your gradient. (Default: 100)

children.name: background_image_size
children.label: Background: Image Size
choices: Native Size (use image's native height and width)

children.name: background_image_parallax_fixed_when_scrolling
children.label: Background: Image Parallax / Fixed When Scrolling
children.help_text: Enable this to make your image fixed so it does not scroll with the rest of the page. The image will remain still regardless of where the user is scrolled. This is similar to a parallax effect but unlike a parallax the image will not move at all. This feature is useful when you need to use the same background image in consecutive sections since it will cause the images to line up with each other when they otherwise wouldn’t. When using this effect, pick your image carefully or use an overlay when needed since since the positioning of the image in relation to your content will be highly dependent on screen size and scroll distance.

children.name: background_fallback_background_image
children.label: Background: Fallback Background Image
children.help_text: This image will show while the video is still loading or on devices which cannot display the video. For best appearance, this image should be identical to the first frame of your video so it seamlessly transitions once the video begins playing. Set the height and width attributes of this input to the height and width of your video file.

children.name: background_offset
children.label: Background: Offset
children.help_text: These inputs determine how much of the height and width of the section this background should cover. This is useful for when you only want a background layer to cover a certain percentage of the section. If your layer should cover the entire height and width of the section, the value of each of these inputs should be 0.

children.name: background_left_offset_percentage
children.label: Background: Left Offset Percentage
children.help_text: This number determines how much of the width of the section this background should cover. This number represents a percentage of the section's width, with 0 being the left edge and 100 being the right edge. Use this input to control the offset from the left edge of the section or set it to 0 if the background should go all the way to the left edge. This number must be less than 100 minus the value of your Right Offset Percentage value, otherwise your background may not display properly. (Default: 0)

children.name: background_right_offset_percentage
children.label: Background: Right Offset Percentage
children.help_text: This number determines how much of the width of the section this background should cover. This number represents a percentage of the section's width, with 0 being the right edge and 100 being the left edge. Use this input to control the offset from the right edge of the section or set it to 0 if the background should go all the way to the left edge. This number must be less than 100 minus the value of your Left Offset Percentage value, otherwise your background may not display properly. (Default: 0)

children.name: background_top_offset_percentage
children.label: Background: Top Offset Percentage
children.help_text: This number determines how much of the height of the section this background should cover. This number represents a percentage of the section's height, with 0 being the top edge and 100 being the bottom edge. Use this input to control the offset from the top edge of the section or set it to 0 if the background should go all the way to the top edge. This number must be less than 100 minus the value of your Bottom Offset Percentage value, otherwise your background may not display properly. (Default: 0)

children.name: background_bottom_offset_percentage
children.label: Background: Bottom Offset Percentage
children.help_text: This number determines how much of the height of the section this background should cover. This number represents a percentage of the section's height, with 0 being the bottom edge and 100 being the top edge. Use this input to control the offset from the bottom edge of the section or set it to 0 if the background should go all the way to the bottom edge. This number must be less than 100 minus the value of your Top Offset Percentage value, otherwise your background may not display properly. (Default: 0)

children.name: quiz_question
children.label: Score Group: Header
children.default: We’re clearly and transparently explaining on our website how much it costs to work with us.

children.name: quiz_question_internal_contact_property_value
children.label: Score Group: Internal Contact Property Value

children.name: quiz_question_explaination
children.label: Score Group: Explanation
children.default:
Why is this so important? Talking about cost/price builds trust. Many businesses are afraid to say how much working with them costs, fearing it will scare sales away, but frankly, hiding your cost is worse. You could end up wasting valuable time on prospects who can’t afford you, or even lose qualified buyers who can because they didn’t want to have to get on the phone to find out. 

When we write blog articles explaining cost and put pricing pages on our websites, we give serious prospects the honesty and transparency they need to feel comfortable buying. They see we’re not trying to trick anyone into a purchase that isn’t right for them. Not only does this build more trust with potential customers, but talking about cost/price on your website has been proven to drive more qualified traffic and leads. So why wait?

What should you do next?

  • Read: How to write a cost/price article
  • Read: Why trust is the true currency for any business
  • Take the Course: How to write the Big 5 
  • Talk to an advisor

children.name: quiz_question
children.label: Question
children.default: Are you consistently producing multiple articles and videos and distributing them online on a weekly basis?

children.name: quiz_question_explaination
children.label: Question: Description
children.default: Think back to the last time you made a big purchase... you probably spent hours researching before talking to a salesperson. Your buyers are doing the same. And now, much of that research is happening on AI platforms like ChatGPT, not Google. AI recommends the companies it trusts and knows best, the ones consistently publishing helpful content. To be seen as a trusted source, you need to produce a steady stream of articles and videos every week that answer real buyer questions that influence buying decisions. If you’re not consistently creating and sharing content that addresses your pricing, problems, and comparisons (we call these The Big 5), you’ll struggle to get picked up by AI.

children.name: cta_ghost_transparent_button
children.label: CTA: Ghost / Transparent Button
children.help_text: Enable this to use a transparent “ghost” style for your button.

children.name: cta_section_anchor_id
children.label: CTA: Section Anchor ID
children.help_text: Add the anchor ID of a section on this page to link to it. To link to a section on a different page, use the Custom Link option and add the section ID to the end of the URL preceded by a hashtag.
